description: The HP-63 code is assigned to the Regional Transport Office (RTO) located in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh. It serves as a primary hub for vehicle registration and licensing, operating out of the state's transport headquarters at Parivahan Bhawan to manage commercial and private transport for the Shimla region.
address: Directorate of Transport, Parivahan Bhawan, Cart Road, Chaura Maidan, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
